text.en: From here, you see what the painting sees.

title.zh: 茅草屋顶

text.zh: 梵高刚到奥维尔，就写信给妹妹：“这里有长着青苔的茅草屋顶，非常棒，我一定会画点什么。”
text.en: Soon after arriving in Auvers, Van Gogh wrote to his sister: “Here there are roofs of mossy thatch which are superb, and of which I'll certainly do something.”

title.zh: 一排破旧的农舍

text.zh: 画面上最显眼的，是一排破旧的农舍。
text.en: A row of dilapidated farm buildings dominates the picture.

title.zh: 科尔德维尔

text.zh: 这些农舍在奥维尔边上一个叫科尔德维尔的小村子里。
text.en: These cottages stood in Cordeville, a tiny hamlet on the edge of Auvers.

title.zh: 起伏的田野

text.zh: 农舍周围是一片起伏的绿色田野。
text.en: All around the cottages, green fields roll away.

title.zh: 空白的天空

text.zh: 天空几乎是空白的，笔触也很快，这幅画可能没有画完。
text.en: The sky is almost blank and the brushwork hasty: the painting may be unfinished.

title.zh: 很宽的画布

text.zh: 画布的宽度正好是高度的两倍，适合画开阔的风景。
text.en: The canvas is exactly twice as wide as it is tall, suited to a broad landscape.

exclusive._说明: 独家发现“没画完的天空”（mirror）：点按钮（或站到画家视角点），放大原画上几乎空白的天空，能看到很快的笔触和露出来的画布，显示卡片5的文字。只是放大原画，不加“这是示意”。crop 照着原画量：画面最上面淡淡的天空和远山。

title.zh: 第一幕 · 来到奥维尔

text.zh: 1890年5月，梵高离开圣雷米的疗养院，搬到巴黎附近的小镇奥维尔。他很快就爱上了这里长着青苔的茅草屋顶。
text.en: In May 1890, Van Gogh left the asylum at Saint-Rémy and moved to Auvers-sur-Oise, a small town near Paris. He soon fell in love with its mossy thatched roofs.

caption.en: July 1890 · Tate, on loan to the National Gallery, London

title.zh: 第二幕 · 科尔德维尔的农舍

text.zh: 7月，他在奥维尔边上的小村子科尔德维尔，画下了这一排破旧的农舍和起伏的田野。这是他最后的风景画之一。
text.en: In July, in the hamlet of Cordeville on the edge of Auvers, he painted this row of old farmhouses and rolling fields. It is one of his last landscapes.

title.zh: 第三幕 · 在伦敦

text.zh: 1933年，收藏家弗兰克·斯托普把这幅画遗赠给了泰特美术馆。今天，它长期借给伦敦国家美术馆，挂在43号展厅，和梵高的其他作品在一起。
text.en: In 1933, the collector Frank Stoop bequeathed this painting to Tate. Today it is on long-term loan to the National Gallery, hanging in Room 43 with Van Gogh's other works.

final.zh: 长着青苔的茅草屋顶，非常棒。
final.en: Roofs of mossy thatch which are superb.
